source_groups.label: Original printed LXXXVIII editorial LXXXIX opening and friends joining
claims: The chapter asks whether someone will join in accord and unity with friends.
Original PDF493/printed459; no independent human observation.
If he shall joyne Concord Unity Friends
Lilly treats agreement and union with friends as the target.
Joining friends is not necessarily romantic love.
He first observes ascendant lord and Moon.
Horary significators are not independent personality measurements.
Application to eleventh lord is proposed as agreement testimony.
The parties are predicted to join and agree.
Sextile or trine is described as favorable.
Such favorable application predicts mutual respect, desire, joy and affection.
These emotional endpoints are distinct from physical joining.
Square or opposition is described as adverse.
Different from no aspect at all.
He expects quarrelling and interpersonal annoyance.
The text ranks opposition as worse than square.
Relative severity is source-side, not calibrated.

source_groups.label: Secret favor request and broader house-specific question
claims: Lilly gives an example of a vaguely phrased private wish or hoped-for object.
Not necessarily a question of friendship.
He considers applying ascendant ruler and Moon to fortunate planets.
He specifically places fortunate planets in angular or succedent houses.
The querent is said to get the secretly desired object.
Without those favorable circumstances Lilly expects nonattainment.
If the wish is disclosed and named, he changes the method.
Ambiguity of the object dictates routing.
The reader must judge the named object through its proper house.
Eleventh-house wish rule should not be applied indiscriminately.

source_groups.label: Mutual love, eleventh seventh third, and twelfth interference
claims: The chapter introduces a distinct inquiry about mutual love.
Separate from prior friends-in-concord and secret wishes.
if one doe love the other
The question is whether one person loves another.
No independent report of either person's feelings.
Lords of eleventh, seventh and third are examined together.
Favorable sextile or trine aspects to the ascendant lord are used.
The favorable configuration is said to show mutual love.
Not a blinded test of attraction.
Adverse square/opposition contacts are also checked.
The adverse relation indicates no love or only outward show.
Apparent friendliness and inner affection are differentiated.
One of the relevant lords linked to twelfth is singled out.
Absence of twelfth-house contact is treated favorably.
Lilly says lack of twelfth-house interference may strengthen love.
all three eleventh seventh third aspect
If all three house lords interconnect from those houses, he anticipates still stronger affection.
Cumulative requirement versus simpler pairwise contact.
This combination is said to intensify affection.
Fixed signs further strengthen the proposed result.

source_groups.label: Following Twelfth House and printed LXXXIX boundary

Chap LXXXIX secret Enemies not named

Separate twelfth-house problem, not a friendship rule.
